ALL: All breeding species occurring at this colony
CARO: Caspian/Royal Tern (used for certain loafing birds)
FOCO: Forster's/Common Tern (used for certain loafing birds)
SDHE: Small Dark Heron/Egret (i.e., Tricolored Heron, Little Blue Heron, or Reddish Egret)
TRSN: Tricolored Heron or Snowy Egret (used for certain Abandoned Nests)
UNHG: Unknown Heron or Egret (see Notes of individual records in tblSpeciesData)
UNIB: Unidentified Ibis (when question of young, wandering WHIB vs. adult DAIB)
UNWA: Unknown Waterbird (likely in proprtion of spp. present in colony)
USTE: Forster's and/or Gull-billed Tern (Unknown Small Tern)
WADE: Wader sp. (used at one colony for abandoned/empty nests)
WHEG: Great/Snowy Egret (and sometimes Cattle Egret too; WH = White)
UNWW: Unknown White Wader (SNEG, WHIB, or REEG WM, as used at Shamrock I in TX in 2021
